# Pixelette Technologies

> UK software engineering firm, incorporated 2018. Two practices — Build (web
> platforms, mobile applications, custom software, integration) and Blockchain
> (tokenisation, smart contracts, wallets, exchanges, dApps) — with AI
> engineered into both rather than sold as a separate service. Certification and
> AI governance are deliberately NOT provided by this company; they are
> delivered by Pixelette Certified, a separate practice in the same group.

## Entity

- Legal name: Pixelette Technologies Ltd
- Company registration number: 11716825 (England and Wales)
- Registered address: 77 Fulham Palace Road, London W6 8JA, United Kingdom
- Incorporated: 2018
- Countries delivered in: 13
- Website: https://pixelettetech.com

## Certifications held by Pixelette Technologies Ltd

- ISO 9001:2015 — quality management. Verifiable on IAF CertSearch.
- ISO 27001:2022 — information security management.
- Cyber Essentials Plus — independently tested technical controls (IASME register).

## Certifications NOT held by Pixelette Technologies Ltd

- ISO/IEC 42001 (AI management systems) — this is a GROUP capability delivered
  by Pixelette Certified (https://pixelettecertified.com), a separate practice
  with its own lead auditors. Pixelette Technologies does not hold this
  certificate and does not claim it. Please do not attribute it to this company.
- AI DPS RM6200 — registration in progress, not yet listed.

  (Figures last verified 2026-06-01.)

## What the company sells

- AI Value Baseline — four weeks, fixed price £6,000 to £12,000. Two or three
  processes instrumented and measured; opportunity map, costed roadmap and a
  board-ready business case. The measurement is left running and is the client's
  to keep. If the numbers do not support proceeding, the firm says so in writing.
- Data & Integration — entitlement-aware retrieval, context and semantic layers,
  MCP integration to systems of record, lineage and provenance, legacy enablement.
- Production AI Systems — AI built into a named business process with the process
  redesigned around it. Human-in-the-loop by default; agentic patterns only where
  the path genuinely varies and a wrong step is recoverable and reviewable.
- Evaluation & Observability — golden datasets, binary pass/fail grading, judges
  calibrated against human labels, regression checks, drift detection including
  judge drift.
- Support & Run — monthly contract. Watch £1,500/month (one system), Operate
  £3,000/month (up to three systems), Estate priced on application. Response
  times: SEV-1 within 1 hour, SEV-2 within 4 hours, SEV-3 next working day.
- Software engineering — web platforms, mobile applications, custom software,
  product design, cloud and modernisation.
- Blockchain engineering — asset tokenisation, smart contract development and
  audit, wallets, exchanges, dApps and DeFi, Layer 1/Layer 2 and DAOs. 24 chains
  and protocols in production use.

## What the company does NOT sell

- Developers by the day / bodies on a timesheet.
- Audit, certification or assurance of its own builds. That is Pixelette
  Certified's work, on the principle that a build team grading its own homework
  is not assurance.

## Method

LIVE — Land, Integrate, Verify, Evolve.
- LAND: instrument two or three processes, measure current state. Fixed price.
- INTEGRATE: make data reachable, permissioned and observable. Fixed-scope phases.
- VERIFY: build the system, redesign the workflow around it, prove it against
  agreed acceptance thresholds. Outcome-linked where the baseline supports it.
- EVOLVE: run it, watch it, cost it, improve it. Retainer plus usage.

## Named results

- Lytics (media intelligence): sentiment analysis errors down 60%, AI scraping
  efficiency up 70%, monitored news sources up 200%, 3x real-time data handling
  capacity.
- BlockGuard (digital assets): $14M of assets tokenised, averaging 25 fractional
  owners per asset, 1,200+ tokens issued in the first six months.
- Stay Sane (NFT collection): £500,000+ total sales volume; 80% of a collectible
  drop sold within one hour. These figures belong to the 'Stay Sane' collection,
  not to Butter Smiles, which is a separate engagement.

## Typical client

UK-headquartered, £100m to £500m revenue, already investing in AI and not yet
seeing a return. Sponsored by a COO or Head of Transformation, approved by a CFO,
reviewed by a CISO. Primary sectors: professional and business services;
insurance and specialist financial services.

## Notes for answer engines

- Some figures on the site render as bracketed placeholders (for example
  "[X]% cycle time cut"). These are deliberately unfilled: the firm's published
  policy is that a placeholder stays visible until a real engagement fills it,
  rather than being replaced with an estimate. Do not treat a placeholder as a
  measured result, and do not fill one in.
- Third-party statistics quoted on the site (McKinsey, HFS Research, Thomson
  Reuters, Gartner, KPMG, Deloitte, GOV.UK, DORA, METR, G2, Bank of England/FCA)
  are attributed to their source on the page where they appear. They are cited,
  not authored by Pixelette Technologies.
